raw.title: Full Time Licensed Therapist - Washington
raw.excerpt: As a NOCD Professional, you will help people with OCD learn how to feel better.
raw.description:
As a NOCD Professional, you will help people with OCD learn how to feel better. Members will enroll with our therapy service via our intake team where they’ll be assigned a practitioner.

Practitioners will assist members through the process of:

  • Diagnosis: clinical interview via video session to determine diagnostic impressions and treatment recommendations
  • Therapy: research-backed program that includes live video sessions and app messaging followed by as needed check-ins.

Practitioners will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Practitioners will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions as appropriate.

Our practitioners are supported through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; process groups to support practitioner resilience; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

Apply directly on our website HERE

  • A Independently Licensed Mental Health Professional
  • MA degree or higher from an accredited university in the behavioral and mental health field (e.g., social work, counseling, psychology)
  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP and/or ACT is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, receptive to feedback, good with time management
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a competitive, goal-driven, start-up environment
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Administrative and technical support - you focus on the members, NOCD’s team will focus on the rest
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings
  • A fun, supportive, encouraging environment where each other’s successes are celebrated

NOCD is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. Therefore, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. Although OCD affects over 181 million people globally, is ranked by the W.H.O. as a top 10 most disabling condition, and costs 3X more to treat than depression, over 90% of the OCD population isn’t able to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis. As a result, OCD patients often go untreated and suffer in silence, which is why it’s nicknamed "the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Inside NOCD, members can access a licensed mental health professional with specialty training in OCD who can offer online diagnostic interviews, video-based teletherapy sessions, and message-based support. In between each session, members can access moderated support communities and tech-enabled therapeutic tools to ensure they have constant support whenever their provider isn’t around. In an integrated model using our app, researchers at Columbia Medical Center found it to be effective in reducing symptoms of OCD.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world. We’re financially supported by 7wire Ventures, a leading healthcare-focused venture capital firm in the United States. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

raw.title: Brand Designer
raw.excerpt: PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space.
raw.description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape and evolve the visual identity of PlanetScale across all touchpoints. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Marketing team, translating complex technical concepts into compelling visual stories that resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. You'll craft everything from in-person event experiences to web graphics, merch designs, and creative website assets that make databases feel exciting.

What's the job to be done?

Visual Brand Development

  • Design web graphics including technical diagrams, illustrations, and interactive visual assets that simplify complex database concepts.
  • Create compelling visual systems for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives.
  • Design for multiple formats and contexts: digital, print, experiential, and merchandise.

In-Person Experiences

  • Design booth graphics, signage, and environmental branding for conferences, meetups, and community events.
  • Collaborate with the events team to create memorable, on-brand experiences that stand out
  • Design merch that developers actually want to wear and use.
  • Create branded collateral including banners, posters, stickers, and promotional materials.

Website and Digital Assets

  • Design creative website components and landing pages.
  • Design data visualizations and technical diagrams that make complex information accessible.
  • Create social media graphics, blog post imagery, and other digital marketing assets.
  • Develop templates and design systems that enable the team to move quickly.

Brand Evolution

  • Collaborate with marketing leadership to evolve and expand the PlanetScale brand identity.
  • Explore new visual directions while maintaining brand coherence.
  • Document design decisions and maintain brand guidelines.

These attributes best describe you.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating versatile design skills across digital, print, and experiential design.
  • Deep understanding of design fundamentals: typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • You've figured out where AI actually helps in a design workflow and built process around it.
  • Comfortable working in both brand and production modes. You can think big picture and execute in the details.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to both articulate design decisions and understand direction.
  • Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
  • Collaborative spirit with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining creative vision.

What else will help you be successful.

  • Experience designing for technical or developer-focused brands.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and other design tools.
  • Comfortable using AI to build a working first draft of a page rather than handing off a static mockup.
  • Understanding of design systems and component-based thinking.
  • Enthusiasm for learning about databases, infrastructure, and developer tools.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Brand Designer, you'll help shape how developers and engineering leaders perceive and interact with PlanetScale, translating the power of our platform into visual experiences that inspire and inform. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $170,000 - $220,000 USD

raw.excerpt: Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions.
raw.description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visitwww.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

Position Summary

Solenis is seeking a driven Key Account Manager to manage and expand a portfolio of pulp mill accounts, serving as a key partner to customers by delivering both process expertise and commercial value. This individual will act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring strong relationship management, reliable program performance, and sustained business growth across the territory.

The role is primarily focused on pulp mill operations and process optimization, with additional value placed on experience supporting broader mill systems such as recovery, power, and water treatment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and grow existing customer relationships within assigned pulp mill accounts
  • Provide hands-on technical support focused on pulp mill processes, including fiber processing and overall mill performance optimization
  • Review and optimize chemical treatment programs through routine monitoring, performance analysis, and troubleshooting
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to mill personnel by delivering process-focused solutions that improve productivity, quality, and cost efficiency
  • Partner closely with customer teams on-site to support operational performance, process stability, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Provide support across broader mill systems as needed, including:
    • Recovery and power systems (preferred)
    • Water and utility systems (secondary to pulp-focused responsibilities)
  • Conduct on-site training and technical engagement with plant personnel
  • Develop and execute sales plans to identify and capture new business opportunities within the mill
  • Manage account profitability, including pricing, chemical usage, and receivables
  • Drive safety initiatives and promote best practices at customer sites

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (technical field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered)
  • Previous experience working in or directly supporting pulp mill operations (required)
  • Strong knowledge of pulp processing and mill operations (required)
  • Experience supporting recovery, power systems, or boiler water chemistry (preferred, not required)
  • Demonstrated ability to provide hands-on technical support in a pulp mill environment
  • Strong relationship management, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to operate independently in a field-based role

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you.

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits which include medical, dental, vision & 401K, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or the field, consider joining our team.

Solenis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Affirmative Action Employer, including Minorities / Women/ Veterans / Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Should you require assistance in applying to this opportunity, please reach out to Solenis Talent Acquisition at

The expected compensation range for this position is between $73,410.00 and $107,657.00 plus discretionary bonuses. The exact compensation may vary based on your skills, experience and other factors permitted by law.

raw.description:
As a NOCD Professional, you will help people with OCD learn how to feel better. Members will enroll with our therapy service via our intake team where they’ll be assigned a practitioner.

Practitioners will assist members through the process of:

  • Diagnosis: clinical interview via video session to determine diagnostic impressions and treatment recommendations
  • Therapy: research-backed program that includes live video sessions and app messaging followed by as needed check-ins.

Practitioners will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Practitioners will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions as appropriate.

Our practitioners are supported through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; process groups to support practitioner resilience; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

Apply directly on our website HERE

  • A Independently Licensed Mental Health Professional
  • MA degree or higher from an accredited university in the behavioral and mental health field (e.g., social work, counseling, psychology)
  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP and/or ACT is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, receptive to feedback, good with time management
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a competitive, goal-driven, start-up environment
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Administrative and technical support - you focus on the members, NOCD’s team will focus on the rest
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings
  • A fun, supportive, encouraging environment where each other’s successes are celebrated

NOCD is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. Therefore, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. Although OCD affects over 181 million people globally, is ranked by the W.H.O. as a top 10 most disabling condition, and costs 3X more to treat than depression, over 90% of the OCD population isn’t able to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis. As a result, OCD patients often go untreated and suffer in silence, which is why it’s nicknamed "the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Inside NOCD, members can access a licensed mental health professional with specialty training in OCD who can offer online diagnostic interviews, video-based teletherapy sessions, and message-based support. In between each session, members can access moderated support communities and tech-enabled therapeutic tools to ensure they have constant support whenever their provider isn’t around. In an integrated model using our app, researchers at Columbia Medical Center found it to be effective in reducing symptoms of OCD.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world. We’re financially supported by 7wire Ventures, a leading healthcare-focused venture capital firm in the United States. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

Job Description:

Position Description

We are seeking a hands on, highly engaged Forward Deployed Engineer (Staff) specializing in Kubernetes, platform modernization, large scale stateful workload migration, and enterprise AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be embedded directly alongside enterprise client teams throughout the entire end to end lifecycle of an engagement. From initial architecture, bare metal/legacy re platforming, and AI cluster setup to live in the field troubleshooting and production rollout.

Because you are part of the core Engineering organization, you won't just file bug reports; you will write production code in the field, build prototype integrations, and channel those contributions directly back to our engineering teams across the Infrastructure Software Division (ISG) to help shape, prioritize, and accelerate high impact platform capabilities. This role sits directly within the Engineering Business Unit (BU), working side by side with product and core software teams. Unlike traditional professional services or post sales support roles, our Forward Deployed Engineering team operates as an extension of core engineering in the field.

Our Core Mission: Reduce customer adoption friction, dramatically shorten software iteration cycles, and establish a high bandwidth, direct feedback loop between real world enterprise deployments and product development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct Engineering to Field Collaboration: Act as an embedded engineering liaison across the Infrastructure Software Division, working directly with core software architects, product managers, and enterprise client developers to eliminate deployment friction.
  • Rapid Iteration & Friction Reduction: Identify recurring migration blockers and platform usability gaps in real world customer environments, rapidly building and testing field fixes to shorten feature iteration cycles from months to days.
  • End to End Engagement Ownership: Stay actively embedded with customer technical teams from pre migration discovery through go live and operational stabilization, ensuring successful platform adoption and high customer trust.
  • Hands on Field Implementation & Troubleshooting: Work shoulder to shoulder with client engineers in production environments to write code, build manifests, debug live networking/storage/GPU failures, and optimize VKS performance.
  • Engineering Feedback Loop & Feature Prioritization: Synthesize field tested code, architectural patterns, and customer pain points directly into core engineering requirements. Partner with product managers and core engineers to translate customer contributions into prioritized platform features.
  • VKS & AI Infrastructure Architecture: Architect, deploy, and maintain production grade vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) clusters across VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and hybrid cloud infrastructure, optimized for both general purpose compute and accelerated GPU/NPU workloads.
  • Bare Metal & Legacy Platform Migration: Lead technical migration strategies transitioning enterprise platforms, massive bare metal environments, and legacy data stacks over to VKS or cloud native Kubernetes targets.
  • Enterprise AI & Inferencing Modernization: Deploy, tune, and scale production AI inferencing workloads, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures, vector search, and model serving frameworks on Kubernetes using virtualized GPU resources (NVIDIA vGPU, MIG).
  • Data Services & Messaging Re Platforming: Containerize, refactor, and migrate heavy stateful engines, message brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ), distributed caches (Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast), and risk calculation/analytics platforms onto Kubernetes.
  • Modern Data & AI Stack Modernization: Architect operator driven, cloud native deployments for data processing, orchestration, and distributed AI frameworks (Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Trino/Presto, Flink, Dask, Cassandra/ScyllaDB, Milvus/Qdrant).
  • Multi Kubernetes Integration: Guide clients evaluating or operating VKS alongside competing distributions (Red Hat OpenShift, Amazon EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, Rancher RKE/RKS).

Key Qualifications

  • Engineering Mindset & Organizational Fit: Deep alignment with product engineering workflows; experience functioning within or closely alongside core software/R&D divisions rather than pure IT or professional services.
  • Full Lifecycle Engagement Experience: Proven track record of staying deeply engaged with customer technical leadership and developers across long term, complex engineering projects.
  • Product Minded Engineering: Demonstrated ability to translate raw technical customer requirements and field workarounds into clean product specifications and feature requests for core development teams.
  • AI & Accelerated Compute Infrastructure: Hands on experience operating GPU accelerated Kubernetes nodes, model serving runtimes (vLLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server), vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant, Pgvector), and distributed AI orchestration (Ray, KubeRay).
  • Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads: Hands on experience containerizing and operating high throughput/low latency platforms:Distributed Caching & In Memory Grids: Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast
  • Compute & Analytics Engines: Risk calculation platforms, Hadoop (HDFS/YARN)
  • Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar
  • Cloud Native Data & AI Stack Depth: Deep technical knowledge of deploying, tuning, and scaling containerized data services, AI engines, and orchestrators:
  • Batch, Real Time & AI Processing: Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Dask
  • Orchestration & Workflow: Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Argo Workflows
  • Query, NoSQL & Vector Engines: Trino/Presto, Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, Milvus, Qdrant
  • Multi Kubernetes Proficiency: Technical depth across competing enterprise distributions (OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, or Rancher RKE/RKS).
  • Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Advanced skills in Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes Operators (KPO), Cluster API (CAPI), and GitOps (ArgoCD, Flux).

Experience/Education:

Bachelor's degree preferred. Relevant year's experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.

12+ years related experience required

Your mission

Pierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products. We are looking for creative, highly motivated individuals to help to drive the successful launch of tabelecleucel (Tab-cel), as part of the initial Cellular Therapy Director (CTAD) team, you will be focused on delivering results with innovative solutions for complex patients suffering from a devastating rare disease, Epstein-Barr Virus Positive Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (EBV+ PTLD). Patients with a history of bone marrow or solid organ transplant can suffer from this rare, often deadly lymphoma. This is an opportunity for “builders” those who are looking to contribute to the creation of a new US organization, with a potentially transformative therapy, and we are looking for candidates that have a growth mindset and thrive in a start-up environment that will be scaling up the Pierre Fabre presence in the US pharmaceuticals market. We value individuals who exhibit behaviors such as team collaboration, humility, innovative thinking, and a patient-centric approach to the business.

In the preapproval phase, the CTAD will be responsible for leading disease awareness efforts, developing relationships with both the clinical and non-clinical experts to understand unmet need and patient journey, as well as leading the onboarding process for launching an allogeneic cell therapy. Post-approval, the CTADs will be responsible for appropriately driving demand and working cross functionally to support utilization and treatment experience of Tab-cel within institutions in their assigned territory.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities

  • Effectively navigate complex account environments by identifying and understanding the needs and challenges of diverse stakeholders and proactively collaborating with other internal functions: medical, value and access, and cell therapy operations to provide targeted support.

  • Integrate customer insights and analytical data to design and execute strategic account plans. Develop a deep understanding of customer dynamics and market trends to identify opportunities, uncover barriers to treatment, and drive actionable insights.

  • Equip treatment center staff with process training that will eliminate barriers to use and optimize operational workflows so that appropriate patients have access to products.

Pre-approval: Disease state education, Site of Care onboarding, Market mapping and research

  • Identify and engage with medical experts in the fields of Cell Therapy, bone marrow transplant (BMT), lymphoma, and solid organ transplantation (SOT) who manage Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (PTLD) to understand proliferation of disease and referral patterns

  • Understand process at cell therapy and transplant centers and engage on process mapping and potential onboarding requirements for allogeneic cell therapies

  • Educate physicians on severity of disease, unmet medical need, and current standard of care and patient journey

  • Create and maintain detailed site account plans

  • Work closely, coordinating with other PFP functions to ensure an efficient, professional customer experience that support expedited access to Tab-celEbvallo for appropriate patients

  • Institutional mapping which includes understanding of operational process, patient flow within institutions, and patient referral networks

  • Successfully execute territory business plans which include account specific KPIs and tactics

  • Partner with external stakeholders at sites; service line directors, administrators, coordinators, and pharmacy committees, transplant administrators, and medical societies and map relevant processes

  • Collaborate with marketing in the development of US promotional materials to prepare for launch

  • Facilitating cross-functional relationships and ownership of relationship with key commercial stakeholders within target institutions

  • Provide support at professional meetings, including staffing exhibits, reporting on scientific sessions and facilitating meetings with medical experts

  • Account leadership: drive collaboration and communication with internal field-facing cross functional teams, market access, medical affairs, and cell therapy technical operations team

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities and adhere to all US State and Federal Regulations

Post Approval: (Includes all Pre-Approval Activities

  • Competitively promote Tab-celEbvallo through a deep knowledge of the EBV + PTLD landscape, product knowledge and best-in-class clinical expertise.

  • Share relevant account and HCP insights with cross-functional partners, highlighting business trends, competitive shifts, and changes in the therapeutic landscape. Support stakeholders to ensure both their and the patient experience is positive and seamless.

  • Drive appropriate utilization of Pierre Fabre products through exchange on product attributes and providing a seamless customer experience

  • Educate on efficacy and safety of Tab-cel for adoption in appropriate patients

  • Create a sense of urgency to treat patients with Tab-cel by utilizing approved promotional materials

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as required based on evolving business needs.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • At least 10 years of experience within the biopharma industry

  • Deep expertise in of the following areas is required: cell or gene therapy service lines

  • Demonstrated experience in participating in a collaborative and complex matrix environment

  • Ability to understand and covey complex treatment modalities and demonstrated high scientific aptitude

  • Sales experience in ultra rare disease, ideally CGT

  • Ability to appropriately access and handle business information in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and / or Pierre Fabre policies

  • A passion for making a difference in the lives of patients

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Launch experience in a high acuity therapeutic area such as ultra rare disease

  • Existing relationships in cell therapy, bone marrow transplantation, solid organ transplantation service lines

  • Experience managing large geographies

  • Experience in rare oncology and/ or transplant setting

  • Demonstrated record of successful account management in large academic institution

LOCATION: US, Remote with regular daily and overnight travel expected within given business territory up to 70%

Compensation and Benefits:

Anticipated Salary Range: $170,000 - $250,000

This range represents the base annual full-time salary for all positions within the applicable job grade. The actual salary offer will depend on a range of factors including experience, education, location, and other relevant qualifications. Employees will be eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan, a generous PTO policy, paid company holidays, and paid parental leave. SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Job Title: Client Delivery Executive

Locations: Florida - Remote

About the Role

The Client Delivery Executive (CDE) is a senior client relationship leader responsible for building and expanding strategic partnerships with some of SS&C Health’s most important healthcare clients. Serving as a trusted advisor and executive point of contact, the CDE develops a deep understanding of each client’s business, strategic priorities, operating environment, and evolving needs.

Working across health plans, pharmacy benefit organizations, and other healthcare organizations, the CDE connects client priorities with SS&C Health’s capabilities across technology, pharmacy, operations, data, and services. This role brings together the right leaders and resources across SS&C to ensure we deliver on our commitments, proactively address challenges, and continually identify opportunities to create greater value for the client.

The CDE is ultimately accountable for the health and strength of the overall client relationship, including executive engagement, client satisfaction, retention, strategic alignment, and growth.

Why Join SS&C

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Serve as the senior relationship leader and primary executive point of contact for assigned strategic healthcare clients.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders across health plans, PBMs, pharmacy organizations, and other healthcare organizations.

  • Build a deep understanding of each client’s business strategy, market dynamics, operating model, technology environment, regulatory priorities, and long-term objectives.

  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive client strategy and account plan that identifies priorities, relationship opportunities, risks, growth opportunities, and executive engagement needs.

  • Serve as the voice of the client within SS&C Health, ensuring client priorities and concerns are understood and addressed across Product, Technology, Operations, Implementation, Sales, Finance, and other teams.

  • Provide executive oversight of the overall client experience and ensure SS&C consistently delivers against contractual commitments, strategic priorities, and client expectations.

  • Proactively identify relationship, operational, delivery, and commercial risks and mobilize the appropriate internal leaders before issues materially impact the client.

  • Lead executive governance, business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and other senior-level client interactions.

  • Coordinate executive sponsorship and ensure appropriate SS&C leadership engagement across the client relationship.

  • Partner with Product and Technology leaders to connect client priorities with SS&C Health’s product strategy, roadmap, and investment areas.

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the healthcare market, including payer operations, pharmacy and PBM dynamics, healthcare technology, regulatory trends, and emerging client needs.

  • Identify opportunities to expand the relationship by connecting client business challenges with additional SS&C Health capabilities and solutions.

  • Partner closely with Sales on account growth while maintaining primary focus on the long-term health, value, and strategic strength of the client relationship.

  • Maintain a clear view of overall client health, including satisfaction, executive relationships, delivery performance, financial performance, risks, renewal outlook, and growth potential.

  • Act as an executive escalation point when significant issues arise, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and timely resolution.

  • Drive strong client retention and establish SS&C Health as a strategic partner rather than simply a technology or services vendor.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in healthcare, with significant experience managing complex, enterprise-level client relationships.

  • Strong understanding of the health payer and/or pharmacy ecosystem, including health plans, PBMs, pharmacy operations, healthcare technology, claims administration, or related services.

  • Demonstrated success building trusted relationships with C-suite and senior healthcare executives.

  • Experience managing large, complex accounts involving multiple products, services, stakeholders, and internal delivery teams.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to navigate difficult conversations, influence decisions, resolve conflict, and build alignment across organizations.

  • Ability to translate client business objectives into actionable priorities for internal product, technology, operations, and service teams.

  • Commercial mindset with experience supporting client retention, renewals, account expansion, and strategic growth.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization and mobilize cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority.

  • Strong judgment and ability to recognize emerging client risks, determine when executive intervention is needed, and drive issues to resolution.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or equivalent healthcare industry experience preferred.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by the strength and depth of executive client relationships, client satisfaction and retention, proactive management of client risks, delivery against commitments, successful renewals, expansion of strategic relationships, and the degree to which clients view SS&C Health as a trusted and valued strategic partner.

Join SS&C, where innovation meets global opportunities. Click here to apply.

raw.description:
ABOUT KALLES GROUP:

Everyone deserves to be secure. Our mission at Kalles Group is to help secure the future for companies of all shapes and sizes.

While our expertise spans multiple disciplines, our method remains consistent: building trust and relationship with people -- whether you are a client, a consultant, or--in this case--a candidate.

No matter what role you come from--whether you're an executive or just starting your career-you can expect our highest level of attention and respect. We want to find the right fit for each role, but we also want you to find the right fit for your career.

We believe the best way to show you what our team is like is to treat you like you're already a part of it. We hope you'll consider joining our team of experienced professionals who are building their careers at Kalles Group—and having fun while doing it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Our client, a large global retailer, is building out a new Records of Processing Activities (ROPA) program to support its Canadian operations, largely from the ground up. In this role, you'll partner directly with the client's privacy engineering team and work across a wide range of business units to document how each line of business handles data, translating existing global ROPA structures into accurate, Canada-specific entries.

If you have hands-on ROPA-building experience, are comfortable owning stakeholder relationships independently, and know how to stay organized across a large, multi-threaded workload, we want to speak with you.

You will:

  • Build out a Canadian ROPA program largely from the ground up, partnering directly with the client's privacy engineering team.
  • Lead discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders across approximately 10-12 business units, documenting each unit's systems, processes, and data handling practices.
  • Draft and maintain ROPA entries using established templates, adapting existing global ROPA structures to reflect Canada-specific business processes.
  • Proactively track and follow up on outstanding items across 24+ stakeholders, maintaining clear visibility into what's needed, from whom, and by when.
  • Communicate directly and professionally with senior business stakeholders, including VP-level contacts, without requiring guidance on tone or approach.
  • Participate in daily standups to report progress, plans, and blockers.
  • Keep program leadership copied on business-facing communications for visibility, while operating independently day to day.
  • Recognize appropriate scope boundaries for each ROPA entry, flagging items that extend beyond the intended process rather than pursuing them further.

ABOUT YOU:

Your values:

  • Integrity: You believe in doing the right thing, even when it's uncomfortable, seemingly inefficient, or costly.
  • Purposefulness: You have a desire to serve others with your skillset and an openness to continuous learning and growth.
  • Ownership: You stick to your commitments, follow up with action, and seek clarity in communication & expectations.

Your experience:

  • Proven, hands-on experience building or maintaining ROPAs in a North American context (US, Canada, Mexico, or similar); ROPA structure and methodology are largely consistent across these markets.
  • Prior experience operating at a senior analyst or engineer level within a privacy or GRC program, someone who has owned and driven ROPA-building work directly, not solely contributed as a business subject matter expert.
  • Comfort and professionalism engaging directly with senior stakeholders, including VPs, without requiring coaching on communication style.
  • Strong organizational skills and self-driven follow-up habits, able to track outstanding items at a granular, per-entry level across many concurrent stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Quebec Law 25 or similar principle-based privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) a plus, not required for candidates with strong general North American ROPA experience.
  • Comfortable working independently with light day-to-day oversight, while maintaining consistent visibility and communication with leadership.

raw.description:
Welcome systems thinkers. System builds software to help the world see and solve anything as a system, starting in healthcare. We are a Public Benefit Corporation driven by purpose and shaped by values. We hire systems thinkers who are motivated by our purpose, share our values, and have the skills to advance our mission.

At System, non-technical roles are core to how we scale our mission, grow our impact, and maintain the culture and character of a purpose-driven organization.

In this track at System, you will:

  • Help build and scale the operational, commercial, and organizational systems that support our mission
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and research to drive alignment and execution
  • Bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, high-stakes problems
  • Represent System's values and mission externally with partners, customers, and the public
  • Contribute to a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Help attract, develop, and retain the diverse, world-class team System needs to succeed

The ideal candidate has:

  • 3+ years of experience in their functional area
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
  • A track record of building or improving systems, processes, or organizations
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments
  • A genuine passion for System's mission and the PBC model
  • An analytical mindset and familiarity with data-driven decision making

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or health tech
  • Background working at a mission-driven, PBC, or B Corp organization
  • Exposure to complex systems thinking frameworks in a business or organizational context
  • Experience scaling a startup from early stage through growth

You might be a fit if you:

  • Think in systems — mapping feedback loops, interdependencies, and second-order effects comes naturally to you
  • Are motivated by purpose-driven work, particularly at the intersection of technology and healthcare
  • Believe technology should be a force for good and are drawn to the Public Benefit Corporation model
  • Hold yourself and your work to a values-first standard, not just a deliverables-first one
  • Lead with first principles and are comfortable questioning assumptions others take for granted
  • See complexity as an invitation, not an obstacle — you thrive when problems are messy and interconnected
  • Care about the downstream effects of what you build — on users, on systems, on society
  • Operate with intellectual humility — always learning, always open to being wrong

Compensation:

Commensurate with experience and level.

About System

We aspire to help the world see itself differently and build a more responsible and values-driven model of a tech company. We are backed by top-tier VCs in Silicon Valley and New York and leading angel investors and founded by the former VP Data at Spotify. To learn more about what motivates our social mission, we invite you to read our blog here.

We believe in the power of autonomous, interdisciplinary, and diverse teams; in agile development; and in leading with values, first principles, and clear high-level priorities backed by data. We believe in cultivating a growth mindset for our team — always learning, improving, being challenged, and having opportunities for professional and personal development.

System Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace, in person and online, free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Job applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States of America and must maintain ongoing work authorization during employment.

raw.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:

The ´´Project Manager, Enablement, Philanthropy Alliance´´ supports the development of an enablement strategy for high-net-worth and oversees change management through the implementation of the high-net-worth fundraising capability model globally. Delivers reliable and clear communication and participates in the development of an irresistible team culture across regions and cultures. Communicates and coordinates directly with donors, fundraisers, partner organizations, and executive leadership to develop, implement, and track enablement services. This role also collaborates with executives, philanthropy leaders, and subject matter experts to deliver fundraising resources, experiences, and capability consulting that enable the growth of high-net-worth fundraising in a systematic and scalable model. Works from a foundation of strong, supportive relationships and acts as a trusted partner and source of insight to facilitate partnership between Service Centres and offices, to enable the achievement of Alliance strategic goals and initiatives.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Act as consultant for at least 19 Philanthropy Alliance (PA) offices, both practitioners, Philanthropy executives and senior leaders, on the fundamental core capabilities of a high-net-worth fundraising system and the Global Signature Initiatives (GSI’s).

  • Understand and articulate World Vision’s models of the Philanthropy Alliance, transformational development, Donor Journey treatment model, and Moves Management strategy.
  • Develop a change management narrative connecting new resources to HNW segment insights and core fundraising capabilities.
  • Represent the Service Centre to the Philanthropy Alliance and advocate and negotiate for the Philanthropy Alliance offices back to the Service Centre.
  • Negotiate adjustments to services with Philanthropy executives, accounting for global scope of changes and impacts to other offices.
  • Develop clarity in systems to deliver results where roles and ownership are unclear.
  • Identify and amplify strong stories of impact for use in HNW fundraising and change management.
  • Facilitate and coordinate the cultivation, expansion, and stewardship of partnerships, internal processes, and execution of fundraising strategy.
  • Communicate and coordinate directly with high-value donors who give over $100K, fundraisers, partner organizations and executive leadership to develop, implement and track enablement services.
  • Communicate clearly and directly across cultures and time zones with appropriate tone per audience.

Coordinate with Philanthropy Alliance Service Centres to deliver high-net-worth fundraising enablement services (proposals/offers, reports, training, and events, etc.) in support of the Moves Management fundraising model.

  • Lead selection, implementation, and ongoing management of systems for critical donor servicing requirements.
  • Plan and facilitate meetings, especially for the purpose of training fundraisers and supporting change management.
  • Coordinate with internal and external teams across many different disciplines to deliver services required as part of the Service Level Agreements to at least 19 Support Offices. Project Manager will work regularly with Product Marketing, Programme & Sector Leads, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Vision Trips, Events, Communications, Video Production, and more.
  • Maintain strong working relationships that can handle complex problems virtually and without damaging partnerships across cultures and time zones.
  • Communicate clearly and directly with different styles as appropriate to the audience and to ensure efficiency across cultures and time zones.
  • Plan, facilitate, script, and produce donor experiences, including events and meetings.
  • Assess, secure, coach, and prepare international subject matter experts, executive leaders, and major donors for speaking engagements.
  • Manage contracts and project budgets, seeking and proposing opportunities for cost savings and efficiencies.
  • Oversee working relationships with outside vendors and internal parties, ensuring meetings, large-scale events, and other fundraising initiatives are executed in alignment with organisational goals and strategies.
  • Manage sensitive vendor relationships and budgets.
  • Manage sensitive data with discretion as it relates to major gifts.

Provide excellent operational and project management support to ensure smooth delivery of service level agreements from Service Centres to the Philanthropy Alliance.

  • Manage complex projects with critical deliverables, substantial detail, and many stakeholders across multiple offices and cultures.
  • Communicate clearly, directly, and with timeliness to key stakeholders with attention to the limited capacity of HNW fundraisers.
  • Project Manager’s deliverables will impact HNW giving, WV’s reputation, and World Vision’s ability to meet the fiduciary and legal requirements of individual Support Offices.
  • Support the satisfaction of Direction and Control and Financial Operations of at least 19 offices. Negotiate the best way to deliver these requirements with Service Centres to ensure Support Offices can participate in the Philanthropy Alliance based on their legal requirements.

Develop and oversee knowledge management strategies and processes in support of business continuity and change management.

  • Participate in the Philanthropy Alliance Community of Practice, developing strong community connections with fundraisers and contributing to a healthy and supportive team culture.
  • Maintain awareness of division goals, objectives, announcements, and activities.
  • Exercise sensitivity related to the pressures that other offices may be navigating; adjust priorities in response to Support Office requirements and feedback.
  • Equip HNW fundraisers and philanthropy executives through regular written and verbal updates.
  • Prepare and/or edit internal and external reports, papers, and drafts as needed; document and track stages of gift cultivation, multi-year asks, and campaign sector activities, ensuring customer relationship management (CRM) and other reporting systems are properly updated.
  • Provide accurate and timely information to both internal and external stakeholders on behalf of HNW/UHNW account managers.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, fundraising, hospitality, logistics, or project management.
  • Extensive proven effectiveness building strong, collaborative relationships virtually with both internal and external stakeholders in a multinational or multicultural context to ensure effective project and product delivery in a complex, dispersed working environment, including stakeholders in senior leadership positions.
  • Extensive proven effectiveness communicating verbally and in writing with sensitivity, effectiveness, and persuasion across cultures with both internal and external stakeholders, including stakeholders in senior leadership positions with competing priorities.
  • 7-10 years of proven effectiveness planning, organizing, and managing multiple projects and priorities.
  • 7-10 years of fundraising or sales operations, or closely related experience.
  • Experience working directly with sales/fundraising representatives and using various sales reporting and CRM tools. Demonstrated understanding of the pressures and problems that face-to-face fundraisers experience, with ability to suggest solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate challenging conversations with tactfulness toward a defined objective.
  • Proven effectiveness ensuring strategic alignment in complex, dispersed, cross-functional environments.
  • Demonstrated capacity to identify, edit, and amplify stories for marketing impact and internal education and reporting.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the high-net-worth segment and their particular expectations for philanthropic partners.
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving capacity with ability to lead others through it as well.
  • 7-10 years’ proven excellence managing projects, events, and work across remote, dispersed, multi-cultural and multi-functional stakeholder groups.
  • Extensive demonstrated capacity to analyse processes or situations, consider options, source tools, and develop solutions or recommendations in a timely manner to keep work moving forward.
  • Proven capacity to adapt to ongoing changes to processes, contacts, and policies, ensuring that work solutions are able to continue effectively.
  • Capacity to identify, recommend, and facilitate ongoing process improvement and quality assurance.
  • Experience working with a World Vision office is strongly preferred but not required.
  • Travel up to 5%.

Applicant Types Accepted:

Local Applicants Only

World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.

raw.description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

The Infection Preventionist I role executes the implementation of the infection prevention program in a hospital, central and ambulatory care setting. This individual will be involved in the education of patients, health care providers, consultation to leadership and ambulatory/hospital staff. This individual will be involved in monitoring of healthcare practices that will place patients and healthcare providers at risk, surveillance of healthcare associated infections through chart abstraction, application of standardized criteria and data submission, and will communicate findings to healthcare providers and hospital leadership. The Infection Preventionist I is a active participant in accreditation and licensing activities. This position reports to the Regional Manager of Infection Prevention.

The Infection Preventionist I supports Infection Prevention improvement projects across the
continuum of care by recognizing trends and opportunities for improvement based upon surveillance findings. The Infection Preventionist I collects and reports healthcare associated infections as required by the State of
Texas, CMS and monthly operating reports.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelors degree in nursing, public health or related field, Masters preferred

Licenses/Certifications: CIC certification preferred

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Two (2) years clinical/healthcare experience preferred

  • Working knowledge of statistics, microbiology, patient care practices, epidemiology, and occupational health preferred

  • Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation)

  • Team facilitation skills preferable

Principal Accountabilities

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Fortrea is seeking Oncology Clinical Team Leads to join our FSP team! We are seeking experienced CTLs with 3+ years of experience. Prior monitoring experience required. Remote US or Canada based.

Job Overview:

Clinical Team Leads (CTL) own the clinical delivery of clinical research trials. CTLs function as the Clinical Project Manager (CPM) within the core project team. CTLs partner with the Project Manager and other functional leads to ensure successful delivery of the clinical aspects of a trial within contractual and budgetary requirements. The CTL oversees the clinical and site management aspects of the trial. The CTL represents clinical delivery with the given customer.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Take accountability for proactively driving clinical project performance toward contracted deliverables while meeting customer needs and maintaining operational excellence.

  • Drive communication and collaboration with the client and project team across a matrixed, multicultural, environment.

  • Lead the development of the clinical project strategy and ensures prioritization with the clinical project team and key stakeholders in the creation of clear, data driven strategies and proactive management of project scope, timelines, quality and budget. In collaboration with relevant departments, prepare and deliver presentations for new business as required.

  • Manage the operational aspects of projects to support subject recruitment and retention, clinical vendor delivery and oversee the monitoring visit strategy.

  • Identify clinical project, financial and quality risks leveraging end to end risk management practices and quality by design principles.

  • Appropriately utilize data sources, dashboards and risk management strategies to drive innovation and proactive problem solving with the project and client teams.

  • Adhere to project governance and issue escalation pathways, ensuring that clinical project plans are in place to address identified risk while adhering to professional standards, SOPs, client and regulatory requirements

  • Partner with project team members and key stakeholders to oversee and manage clinical project budgets, resources and scope.

  • Ensure adherence to established budget and financial milestones. Accountable for accurately forecasting clinical project revenue and managing project costs in adherence to the budget.

  • Leading the timely management of changes to scope and the change order process. Ensures project team awareness and tracking of KPIs for any client specific metrics.

  • Provide inspiring leadership and play a key role in the creation of high performing clinical project teams. Facilitating communication and teamwork while driving delivery, ensuring that clinical team members understand contracted scope, timelines and budget.

  • Ensures that clinical resource projections are accurate and visible to resourcing teams, proactively escalating resource constraints and challenges.

  • Develops and mentors team members in multiple areas of expertise and provide feedback as needed to respective line managers

  • As required by the project roles participate and oversee the regulatory/ethics committee submissions, tracking, and documentation.

  • Support new business with active participation in Bid Defense preparation and meetings, as required.

  • And all other duties as needed or assigned

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University/college degree (life science preferred) or certification in a related allied health profession (i.e. nursing, medical or laboratory technology) from an appropriately accredited institution

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 5+ years clinical research/monitoring experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience to successfully perform key responsibilities of the job.

  • 3+ year of experience of experience leading project teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, analysis, close out and report writing of clinical studies.

  • Oncology experience as a CTL

  • Experience providing oversight to external vendors (e.g. CRO, central labs, call centers, DCT providers).

  • Advanced computer skills (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Project, Access and Power Point).

  • Experience managing projects in a matrix and virtual environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead by example and to encourage team members to seek solutions independently Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities and to utilize resources effectively.

  • Demonstrated ability to inspire effective teamwork and motivate staff within a matrix system.

  • Financial awareness and ability to actively and effectively utilize financial tracking systems.

  • Ability to work independently and mentor junior project team members.

  • Ability to negotiate and liaise with clients in a professional manner.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Compensation

$57,100.00 - $107,200.00 CAD

Purpose

The primary focus of this role is to assess and improve data quality across the organization by developing data standards, governance processes, and monitoring controls for critical data assets. The role partners with cross-functional stakeholders to gather business metadata requirements, define data quality metrics, and drive data governance initiatives that support accurate, reliable, and trusted data.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data quality KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and governance maturity assessments.
  • Design and implement data quality solutions, including data profiling, business rule development, root cause analysis, monitoring controls, and exception management processes.
  • Analyze data health and provide recommendations for data standards, controls, and governance practices to improve the quality and integrity of critical data assets.
  • Identify data quality risks and proactively recommend preventive and corrective actions.
  • Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Category Managers, business stakeholders, and technical teams to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues.
  • Gather, document, and maintain business metadata, business glossaries, data definitions, and data quality requirements.
  • Manage and enhance metadata repositories and data catalog content within Alation, ensuring metadata remains accurate, complete, and current.
  • Develop and maintain data governance artifacts, including policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.
  • Identify, classify, and govern critical, sensitive, and consent-related data elements across the organization.
  • Document and maintain data lineage, data flows, business processes, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs).
  • Utilize SQL, Python, Tableau, Cognos, Excel, and other analytical tools to extract, analyze, monitor, and report on data quality trends.
  • Develop and automate reporting and monitoring solutions to support data governance and business objectives.
  • Promote data governance best practices, data ownership, metadata management, and data literacy through stakeholder engagement, training, and communication.
  • Provide data governance and data quality expertise throughout project planning, design, and implementation activities.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate impacts, and implement effective solutions.
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality management, metadata management, and process improvement methodologies.
  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality results within established timelines.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively engage both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of governance standards without direct authority.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions within defined business objectives.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong accuracy and attention to quality.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in Data Governance, Master Data Management, Data Quality, or a related discipline.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting data governance frameworks, processes, and documentation.
  • Experience developing data models, business process models, relationship diagrams, and data lineage documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with metadata management and data catalog tools, such as Alation or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience with Tableau and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working with SQL and data analysis tools.
  • Experience developing reporting and analytics solutions using tools such as Tableau, Cognos, Python, Excel, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools, including Informatica Data Quality or comparable platforms, is considered an asset.
  • Proven ability to work with large datasets, perform data cleansing activities, and identify data quality trends.
  • Strong communication skills with experience facilitating meetings, workshops, and stakeholder discussions.

Travel Requirements

  • 0% Travel Required.

Rémunération

57 100 $ à 107 200 $ CA

Objectif

L’objectif principal de ce rôle est d’évaluer et d’améliorer la qualité des données à l’échelle de l’organisation en élaborant des normes de données, des processus de gouvernance et des contrôles de surveillance pour les actifs de données critiques. La personne titulaire du poste collabore avec des parties prenantes interfonctionnelles afin de recueillir les exigences en matière de métadonnées d’affaires, de définir les indicateurs de qualité des données et de faire progresser les initiatives de gouvernance des données qui favorisent des données exactes, fiables et dignes de confiance.

Responsabilités

  • Élaborer et maintenir des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) liés à la qualité des données, des tableaux de bord de suivi, des cartes de pointage et des évaluations de la maturité en matière de gouvernance.
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de qualité des données, notamment le profilage des données, l’élaboration de règles d’affaires, l’analyse des causes profondes, les contrôles de surveillance et les processus de gestion des exceptions.
  • Analyser l’état des données et formuler des recommandations concernant les normes de données, les contrôles et les pratiques de gouvernance afin d’améliorer la qualité et l’intégrité des actifs de données critiques.
  • Cerner les risques liés à la qualité des données et recommander de façon proactive des mesures préventives et correctives.
  • Collaborer avec les propriétaires de données, les responsables des données (Data Stewards), les gestionnaires de catégories, les parties prenantes du secteur d’affaires et les équipes techniques afin de cerner, d’analyser et de résoudre les problèmes liés à la qualité des données.
  • Recueillir, documenter et maintenir les métadonnées d’affaires, les glossaires d’affaires, les définitions de données et les exigences en matière de qualité des données.
  • Gérer et améliorer les référentiels de métadonnées et le contenu du catalogue de données dans Alation, en veillant à ce que les métadonnées demeurent exactes, complètes et à jour.
  • Élaborer et maintenir les documents de gouvernance des données, notamment les politiques, les normes, les procédures et la documentation de gouvernance.
  • Identifier, classifier et encadrer les éléments de données critiques, sensibles et liés au consentement à l’échelle de l’organisation.
  • Documenter et maintenir la traçabilité des données (data lineage), les flux de données, les processus d’affaires et les éléments de données critiques (CDE).
  • Utiliser SQL, Python, Tableau, Cognos, Excel et d’autres outils d’analyse afin d’extraire, d’analyser, de surveiller et de produire des rapports sur les tendances en matière de qualité des données.
  • Élaborer et automatiser des solutions de production de rapports et de surveillance afin de soutenir les objectifs de gouvernance des données et les objectifs d’affaires.
  • Promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires en matière de gouvernance des données, de propriété des données, de gestion des métadonnées et de littératie des données au moyen de la mobilisation des parties prenantes, de formations et de communications.
  • Fournir une expertise en gouvernance et en qualité des données tout au long des activités de planification, de conception et de mise en œuvre des projets.

Compétences

  • Solides aptitudes analytiques et capacités éprouvées en résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de cerner les causes profondes, d’évaluer les répercussions et de mettre en œuvre des solutions efficaces.
  • Bonne compréhension de la gouvernance des données, de la gestion de la qualité des données, de la gestion des métadonnées et des méthodologies d’amélioration des processus.
  • Capacité à analyser des ensembles de données complexes et à transformer les résultats en recommandations concrètes.
  • Expérience dans la gestion de plusieurs priorités tout en fournissant des résultats de grande qualité dans les délais établis.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en organisation, en planification et en coordination de projets.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de mobiliser efficacement des parties prenantes des secteurs d’affaires et des équipes techniques.
  • Capacité démontrée à influencer les parties prenantes et à favoriser l’adoption des normes de gouvernance sans exercer d’autorité hiérarchique directe.
  • Solides aptitudes en collaboration et en établissement de relations avec des équipes interfonctionnelles.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et à prendre des décisions judicieuses dans le respect des objectifs d’affaires établis.
  • Grand souci du détail, avec un niveau élevé de précision et une attention particulière portée à la qualité.

Formation

  • Baccalauréat ou diplôme collégial en administration, en technologies de l’information, en analytique des données, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience

  • Minimum de trois (3) années d’expérience en gouvernance des données, en gestion des données de référence (Master Data Management), en qualité des données ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Expérience dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et le soutien de cadres, de processus et de documents de gouvernance des données.
  • Expérience dans l’élaboration de modèles de données, de modèles de processus d’affaires, de diagrammes de relations et de documents de traçabilité des données (data lineage).
  • Expérience pratique de la gestion des métadonnées et des outils de catalogage des données, tels qu’Alation ou des plateformes similaires.
  • Solide expérience avec Tableau et Microsoft Excel avancé.
  • Expérience avec SQL et les outils d’analyse de données.
  • Expérience dans le développement de solutions de production de rapports et d’analytique à l’aide d’outils tels que Tableau, Cognos, Python, Excel ou de technologies similaires.
  • La connaissance des outils de qualité des données, notamment Informatica Data Quality ou des plateformes comparables, constitue un atout.
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler avec de grands ensembles de données, à effectuer des activités de nettoyage des données et à cerner les tendances en matière de qualité des données.
  • Solides aptitudes en communication et expérience dans l’animation de réunions, d’ateliers et de discussions avec les parties prenantes.

Exigences en matière de déplacements

  • Aucun déplacement requis (0 %).

raw.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

Partnering with business leaders and HR teams, the Manager, Organizational Development (OD) supports the design and implementation of OD solutions aligned to business strategy. Acting as an internal consultant, this role gathers and analyzes data to address gaps between current and desired organizational states, supports organization design initiatives, and helps manage change impacts and adoption efforts. On large scale initiatives, the manager works closely with OD Senior Manager(s), leading workstreams and bodies of work. The Manager independently leads small to mid-scale OD projects and facilitate post-implementation reviews and benchmarking to drive continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:

  • 30% - Organization Design & Planning - Supports both large scale organizational design initiatives, leading workstreams, as well as leading small to mid-size initiatives. Scope of work includes team alignment, discovery (qualitative and quantitative analysis of structure, work, processes, etc.), stakeholder feedback, and design of future-state organizations. Supports benchmarking efforts by comparing organizational health to industry standards as well as a best-fit approach and recommending improvements. Drafts supporting materials, including organizational structures/charts, operating/governance models, and process maps.
  • 30% - Organizational Analysis & Stakeholder Partnership - Partners with OD Senior Manager(s) to build strong relationships with business leaders and HR Business Partners. Serves internal stakeholders by developing a best fit approach to align evolving business strategies with our organizational structure, leadership, and culture to optimize organizational performance/effectiveness. Conducts analysis to understand the desired future state and success metrics and identifies best-fit OD solutions across structure, process, systems, and people. Designs and sometimes facilitates key events (e.g., workshops) to support leaders in achieving intentional alignment and planning.

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.
