It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Our ClinicalBudget Analyst will interpret protocols from a financial perspective; develop clinical trial budgets, negotiate pricing, and present budget proposals to executive management.

This position is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.

Duties include and are not limited to:

  • Creating new budgets in Excel based upon Sarah Cannon cost and charge information, analyzing each clinical trial protocol in order to provide a detailed counteroffer to the Sponsor's initial budget while meeting established metrics surrounding each budget

  • Negotiating budgets with Sponsors/CROs in order to result in a favorable overall result for Sarah Cannon, while establishing and maintaining business relationships for future negotiations

  • Maintaining and effectively communicating to executive management statuses for all assigned budgets

  • Proactively communicating and soliciting input from clinical staff, management and others in order to receive timely clarification on protocol specifics, standard of care, billable items and other nuances affecting the budget

  • Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required with at least 1 year work experience utilizing basic financial principles, Microsoft Excel, and other data management tools

  • At least 1 year of experience in budget negotiation

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions such as VLOOKUP, SUMIF, and other complex formulas

  • Familiarity with clinical research and/or medical terminology

  • Functional knowledge of clinical trials, preferred

  • Analytical decision-making skills and Project management capabilities

  • Strong negotiation and professional communication skills

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

raw.title: Senior Director, Energy Systems, Global
raw.excerpt: About VantageVantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises.
raw.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Product Department

The Product team at Vantage defines and stewards our global product platform: the customer outcomes we aim to deliver, the standards and reference approaches that make delivery repeatable, and the closed-loop learning that turns each deployment into an upgrade for the next. We do this in partnership with Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Procurement, Sustainability, Sales, Site Selection, and Business Development, aligning priorities and trade-offs while preserving clear functional ownership for design execution, construction delivery, and site operations.

Position Summary

Vantage is building the next generation of digital infrastructure through industrialized product platforms, standardized deployment systems, and long-range technology strategy. As demand for AI, advanced computing, and digital infrastructure continues to accelerate, energy hasemergedas the defining constraint to growth. The ability toacquire, integrate,optimize, and scale energy infrastructure has become a strategic differentiator.

The Senior Director, Energy Systemsis responsible fordefining and stewarding Vantage’s global energy systems strategy and product roadmap.

This role owns the vision, strategy, and development of the energy layer of the Vantage product platform, translating evolving utility markets, interconnection and regulatory changes, customer requirements, power infrastructure constraints, grid modernization trends, and validated technology innovations into scalable energy products and deployment models.

The position serves as the primary product steward for Vantage’s energy systems portfolio, including behind-, front-, across-the-meter energy solutions, power generation integration, energy storage, grid-interactive infrastructure, energy optimization systems, and future energy platform capabilities.

Success in this role requires a demonstrated blend of commercial, technical, and strategicexpertise. The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of energy markets, energy contracting and partnerships, utility interconnection processes, many power generation technologies, transmission and distribution systems, and energy infrastructure development, while also understanding how to convert those capabilities into repeatable product offerings that create long-term competitive advantage. First-hand experience is preferred, especially across multiple regions (e.g., utilities / balancing authorities, ISOs / RTOs), types of energy partners (e.g., OEMs, EPCs, IPPs), and partnership methods (e.g., JV, equity, co-development).

Working closely with teams across the Energy and Productorganizationsthis individual will ensure energy innovations evolve into scalable platform capabilities that can be consistently deployed across Vantage’s global footprint.

Role Purpose

The Senior Director, Energy Systems is accountable for defining the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and product portfolio governing the energy layer of the Vantage platform.

The roleestablisheshow energy infrastructure, generation resources, storage systems, utility relationships, grid integration strategies, and emerging energy solutions contribute to customer value, capacity growth, resilience, speed-to-market, and long-term business performance.

The Senior Director, Energy Systems owns the integration of those validated technologies into the product roadmap, platform architecture, deployment strategies, and regional enablement models.

The role also serves as a bridge between innovation and scale — ensuring that evolving energy capabilities move beyond successful pilots and become durable, repeatable, globally deployable product offerings while also communicating energy needs back to inform the next generation of innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Global Energy Strategy

  • Develop multi-year roadmaps for energy infrastructure, power acquisition strategies, generation integration, storage deployment, and grid-connected energy solutions.

  • Translate customer requirements, market intelligence, supply chain constraints, utility dynamics, interconnection evolution, regulatory changes, and policy developments into product direction and investment priorities.

  • Evaluate future energy trends anddeterminewhere Vantage should build, buy, partner, or influence.

  • Develop executive-level strategic recommendations and investment cases for energy-related initiatives.

Energy Systems Product Portfolio

  • Own the product strategy and portfolio for energy-related platform capabilities.

  • Define repeatable energy system architectures, deployment models, standards, and intentional variants.

  • Establish energy product requirements and roadmap priorities aligned to Vantage’s regional and customer growth strategies.

  • Create scalable approaches for: power generation integration, energy storage systems, grid-interactive infrastructure, load flexibility and energy optimization, utility coordination frameworks, and energy management and control systems.

  • Ensure energy capabilities are developed as reusable platform components rather than project-specific solutions.

Utility, Interconnection & Power Market Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership on utility engagement and grid infrastructure considerations.

  • Proactively translate evolving grid requirements into the energy platform.

  • Develop frameworks and guidance relatedto:utility partnerships, grid interconnection strategy, capacity acquisition approaches, transmission and distribution considerations, and power market participation opportunities.

  • Support strategic customer opportunities requiring sophisticated energy solutions.

  • Evaluate regional power market dynamics and their implications for platform strategy.

Road mapping & Technology Integration

  • Partner closely with the Senior Director, Advanced Technologies to incorporate validated innovations into the Vantage product roadmap and provide evolving energy needs to inform the next generation of innovation.

  • Translate technology pilot outcomes and validation results into product requirements, deployment standards, and investment priorities.

  • Collaborate with Product Engineering to ensure roadmap decisions are reflected through reference architectures and design standards.

  • Ensure technology adoption decisions align with long-term platform goals, deployment realities, and business outcomes.

  • Serve as the primary product leader responsible for connecting innovation activity with scalable product development.

Regional Partnership & Deployment Enablement

  • Establish a product deployment framework for energy systems aligned to Vantage’s product operating model.

  • Partner closely with regional energy leaders across North America, EMEA, and APAC to ensure product strategies are deployable and aligned to market realities.

  • Build repeatable mechanisms for regional adoption, execution, and feedback.

  • Translate regional insights into future roadmap enhancements.

  • Define global standards while enabling intentional regional flexibility whererequired.

  • Support Product Deployment teams in connecting energy products to specific customer and project opportunities.

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Alongside regional partners, develop strategic relationshipswith:utilities, independent power producers, energy developers, grid operators, technology providers, equipment manufacturers, and infrastructure investors.

  • Identifypartnership opportunities that accelerate product capabilities and create market differentiation.

  • Represent Vantage in strategic discussions related to energy infrastructure and future power systems.

  • Support executive engagement with customers, regulators, and energy ecosystem partners.

Leadership Expectations

The Senior Director, Energy Systems is expected tooperateas a strategic leader who influences outcomes across a highly matrixed global organization.

Successrequires:

  • Strong systems thinking and strategic judgment withanability to connect technology, infrastructure, commercial realities, and customer outcomes.

  • Executive-level communication skills capable of influencing senior leadership and external stakeholders.

  • A collaborative leadership style that builds alignment across Product Strategy, Product Engineering, Product Operations, Product Deployment, Regional Energy Teams, Delivery, Sustainability, Procurement, and Finance.

  • Comfort making decisions amid uncertainty whilemaintaininga long-term platform perspective.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Power Engineering, Engineering Management, or related field.

  • 15+ years of experience in energy infrastructure, utilities, generation development, energy systems, power markets, or related industries.

  • Demonstrated experience leading both commercial and technical aspects of energy-related initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of energy project economics, investment analysis, and strategic business case development.

  • Proven ability to develop strategic roadmaps and convert complex technical topics into business decisions, especially a repeatable, scalable product.

Preferred Qualifications

  • First-hand experience in hyperscale infrastructure, data centers, utility-scale energy development, transmission development, or grid modernization.

  • Experience with utility interconnection studies and power procurement strategies.

  • Knowledge of distributed energy resources, microgrids, energy storage systems, energy optimization, and grid services.

  • MBA,Master’s in Engineering, Energy Systems, or related advanced degree.

Why This Role Matters

Energy is increasingly becoming the limiting factor for digital infrastructure growth. Vantage’s future success will depend on its ability to transform energy from a project-level constraint into a scalableplatformcapability.

The Senior Director, Energy Systems will play a foundational role in defining that future — creating the strategies, roadmaps, partnerships, and deployment models that enable Vantage to integrate energy infrastructure as a corecomponentof its global product platform.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $240,000-$260,000K Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

A High Value at Risk (HVAR) Collection agent is responsible for protecting our value proposition, reducing our assignments to third parties, and maximizing liquidation of the portfolios worked by the team.

    Utilize highly effective analytic skills to quickly determine the root cause of delinquency and propose appropriate options on individual accounts to minimize loss, mitigate overall risk to BMO and preserve customer loyalty, where possible.
  • Focus at all times on loss protection to the bank and ensure that every effort is made to preserve the bank's relationship with the customer for this and future transactions, products and services.
  • Performs other duties and special projects as required.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • Identify potential financial, legal, reputational risks and engage management team
  • Leverage and share best practices and specialized knowledge with teammates and collections organization
  • Collaborate closely with multiple lines of business within the organization to mitigate risk and improve performance and compliance.

COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Comply with all applicable BMO and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.
  • Maintain BMO’s professional image and Code of Conduct.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security standards.

AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS

  • Drive the decision making process based on gathered facts, data, observation, and analysis
  • Communicate and present information to various management levels within BMO.

JOB DIMENSIONS

  • Leverage networks and improve knowledge of collection, governance, audit and compliance practices to effectively adapt collections strategies in response to findings, changes in market conditions and/or legislations.
  • Research, gather data, analyze, lead and/or provide support, as required and recommend solutions to management.
  • Represent the business unit as a subject matter expert in inter-departmental policy and procedures implementation and meetings

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Extensive understanding of secured and unsecured portfolios
  • Good working knowledge of Bank supported or other software ie: Excel, Word, Microsoft Office etc.
  • Good working knowledge of Bank Systems ie: Strata, ECP, angular tool, TSYS, Optimizer, MDIF
  • Good working knowledge of Financial Statements, Bank OFSI standards and Business Recovery Planning.
  • Good practical knowledge of Business Computer Systems
  • Excellent knowledge of Collection Processes and Procedures
  • Knowledge of skip tracing techniques and good skip tracing skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Professional and courteous phone manner in order to deal effectively with customers and sensitive situations.
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, negotiation and decision making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve difficult client exchanges through high quality, service oriented interactions.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

The Opportunity:

CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:

The Revenue Cycle Senior Analyst will be responsible for establishing and executing a vision for the delivery of information and analytics to key stakeholders that elevates the organization’s financial and operational performance. A key responsibility in this role is back end acute operational support, such as: working on the business acute back-end coordinator, Acute back end KPI Scorecard, , executive status, cash performance metrics, Acute back end TIPS reporting, various reporting needs for Acute back end operations, Acute back end project coordination/support , and performance monitoring, analyst and notification. This role will support and at times direct senior staff by assisting with resource planning and delegation work.

  • Analyze financial and business performance against key business metrics and document pertinent financial highlights that will enable Management to determine progress against strategic plans
  • Identify and report financial/operational opportunities and cost savings measures

  • Ensure that all projects are completed on time, within scope and all barriers are communicated to the appropriate parties
  • Establish and maintain interdepartmental relationships will all stakeholders

  • Prepare proformas regarding changes in service lines and/or staffing structure
  • Anticipates executive leadership needs by gathering records, reports, data and correspondence for accurate reporting, prepares various documents and handles confidential matters, provides ad hoc reporting for when requested, coordinates and plans special training sessions
  • Informs executive leadership of potential operational problems after analysis of data
  • Works with members of analytics to research data nuances, determine patterns, quantify and communicate impact, and propose solutions for registration issues, Responsible for verification of the accuracy of the data being reported
  • Analyzes variances and trends to identify problems and/ or trend.

raw.excerpt: Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500.
raw.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

With so many organizations using Postman, we are looking for an exceptional Corporate Solutions Engineer to join our team & help us support the growth of our customers in the corporate market. You will partner with our corporate sales team to promote an API-first development culture, nurture customer relationships, and guide Postman users in leveraging our platform to build their APIs most effectively. Ideally, we are looking for someone who lives & breathes APIs, has experience in corporate sales, is comfortable with JavaScript & is an expert Postman user already!

In addition to working with a product that customers already know and love, our sales, customer success, product, and engineering teams will support you well in this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Help drive sales by nurturing prospects & supporting customers in our corporate market
  • Conduct discovery, qualification, technical demos, & proof of value workshops with prospective customers looking to embrace Postman for their API lifecycle
  • Handle Postman technical questions or objections & provide solutions or workarounds to address customer needs
  • Produce reusable collateral that can be distributed to help our prospective customers understand how to adopt API-first practices with Postman.
  • Understand deeply our customer workflows today & how they can adopt API-first development best practices
  • Share customer feedback with appropriate teams & provide general customer advocacy
  • Remain up-to-date with the competitive landscape, current trends, & challenges in the API market
  • Create proof of concept integrations, tooling, & workflows as needed to support prospective customers
  • Maintain & develop customer sandbox environments & best practices for working with the product
  • Act as a technical intermediary between sales & other teams to best fit our customer needs

About You

  • 4+ years of corporate sales/solutions engineering experience
  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • 3+ API’s and Data platforms experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or relevant work experience
  • Ability to travel up to 25%
  • Loves teamwork & collaboration in a fast-paced environment
  • Customer-facing experience & comfortable engaging all levels of technologists, including individual developers, QA, product, & engineering leaders
  • Strong understanding of APIs, & experience with producing & consuming APIs across different domains
  • Strong knowledge of modern development methodologies & DevOps with an appreciation of the software development life cycle
  • Comfortable with the SaaS sales process & common security concerns of cloud services
  • Experience executing sales strategies & sales methodologies like MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, Command of the Message, etc.
  • Excellent listener who seeks to understand what a customer is trying to achieve rather than pre-supposing solutions
  • Familiar with typical developer tooling: IDEs, Git, CI/CD, monitoring services, microservices, containers, cloud computing services, etc.
  • Fast learner, excited & willing to learn new technology on an ongoing basis
  • Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal & written)

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

raw.description:
About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Position

Cardlytics is seeking a highly organized, candidate-centered Talent Acquisition Specialist to support our lean, high-impact Talent Acquisition function. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys balancing recruiting operations with talent sourcing and candidate engagement.

You will serve as a key partner to the Head of Talent Acquisition, helping deliver a thoughtful, efficient hiring experience for candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers. You will manage the details that keep hiring moving - from interview coordination and candidate communication to sourcing, screening, offer administration, and ATS workflow management.

This role is ideal for a recruiting professional who is comfortable operating independently, can manage competing priorities with sound judgment, and is eager to grow into broader full-cycle recruiting ownership.

You will

  • Coordinate complex interviews, calendars, and interviewer panels; manage reschedules and ensure a seamless candidate experience.

  • Own candidate communications throughout the process, including interview confirmations, preparation, follow-up, and status updates.

  • Partner with the Head of TA to source and build diverse pipelines for priority roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, referrals, talent mapping, and other outbound strategies.

  • Review resumes and conduct structured initial screens for defined roles, evaluating core qualifications, motivation, and alignment with role requirements.

  • Maintain accurate, timely data and workflows, including candidate stages, interview feedback, requisition activity, and reporting.

  • Coordinate offer-process administration, including drafting offer letters and employment documentation, initiating background checks, and managing candidate pre-hire workflows.

  • Monitor interview feedback and follow up with interviewers and hiring teams to keep processes moving and decisions timely.

  • Partner with the Head of TA and hiring teams to deliver a consistent, professional, and equitable interview process.

  • Identify friction points in the hiring experience and recommend practical improvements to workflows, templates, systems, and communication.

  • Support additional recruiting and people-team initiatives as business needs evolve.

  • Support full-cycle recruiting for assigned, lower-complexity searches as experience and readiness develop.

You have

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting, recruiting operations, talent sourcing, or recruiting support in an in-house or agency environment.

  • Demonstrated success managing complex interview scheduling, multi-stakeholder communications, and confidential candidate information.

  • Strong sourcing fundamentals, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, candidate research, and outreach.

  • Experience conducting candidate phone screens or a clear ability to learn structured screening quickly.

  • Exceptional organization, detail orientation, follow-through, and written communication skills.

  • Sound judgment and comfort managing shifting priorities in a fast-moving, resource-conscious environment.

  • A candidate-first mindset and high bar for service, responsiveness, and professionalism.

  • Ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate issues, risks, or decisions.

  • A growth mindset and interest in developing into a full-cycle recruiting professional.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is $100–$125 USD. Actual compensation will vary based on location, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Act with urgency and focus

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

  • Empowerment over hierarchy

  • Growth over comfort

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible paid time off plus company holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance begins on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plan also includes a student loan debt repayment option

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Educational assistance for continuing education

  • Lifestyle Spending Account for physical, emotional, and financial wellness (like gym memberships, home down payments, art classes, park passes, and more!)

  • Complimentary Calm app subscriptions to support employee mental health and wellbeing

As an equal opportunity employer, Cardlytics is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our people bring our products and organization to life, and every unique perspective makes us better. If you can do the job and you’re excited about growing with us as we scale our best-in-class advertising platform, we’d love to hear from you. If you need accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please email or inform your recruiter.

raw.excerpt: Who we are. raw.description:
Who we are.

Network Solutions, a global leader helping small businesses succeed online with websites, domains, hosting and more, is looking for a creative, hands-on Senior PR Manager to turn our multi-channel content engine into meaningful earned media coverage, and to make sure that coverage lives well beyond the press hit.

This is a role for a proactive PR professional, someone who has independently run PR programs end-to-end, knows how to spot a story before others see it, and has the media relationships and instinct to turn insights into headlines. You’ll also be the connective tissue between PR and social storytelling, making sure our biggest data studies, press wins, and executive moments get a second life on social.

Your work begins with curiosity. You will dig into blogs, survey data, customer stories, product roadmaps, SEO insights, and conversations with in-house experts to uncover story ideas worth sharing. Then, as a story strategist, you will transform those insights into narratives that align with our brand priorities and resonate with the media. You will collaborate closely with the Content, Customer Insights, SEO, Video and Social teams to shape data-driven narratives and craft story angles that extend across channels, powered by strong editorial instincts and the best of AI. Finally, you will partner with our PR firm to collaboratively and individually pitch those stories to top-tier, trade, tech, and SMB outlets, and partner with Social to carry them forward.

You will play a key role in connecting PR strategy to our broader storytelling across blog, social, video, and executive visibility. This is not a reactive press release role; it is a strategic, high-impact seat at the content table. You won’t just mine stories, pitch drafts or write press releases, you will connect teams, elevate ideas, and help shape how the world sees a global brand in motion.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Spot the story before it’s assigned. Monitor content calendars, product roadmaps, survey insights, and customer trends to proactively surface timely media angles and earned coverage opportunities.

  • Shape and execute strategic media campaigns. Drive a steady flow of high-impact, customized pitches supported by press releases, quotes, bylines, and reporter prep materials, all crafted by you to align with brand messaging and business goals.

  • Lead data-driven storytelling, start to finish. Partner closely with our Content lead and our data-journalism research partner to shape study topics from the headline down, review research drafts for newsworthiness, and work with our PR agency partner on pitching — ensuring every study is built for amplification across PR, blog, social and video.

  • Be the bridge between PR and Social. Serve as the direct link to the Social team, making sure published research, data studies, and press wins are translated into engaging, platform-native social content — and champion executive leaders in authoring long-form LinkedIn articles tied to key studies and results.

  • Amplify executive thought leadership. Identify and secure opportunities for leaders to contribute commentary, interviews, podcasts, bylines, and timely expert perspectives (often helping to draft these) in top-tier media and on their own social channels.

  • Cultivate strong press relationships. Deepen visibility across tech, SMB, trade, and data-driven business press through consistent, tailored outreach via email, social and calls.

  • Use AI tools to work smarter. Leverage AI to brainstorm, outline, personalize and accelerate story development, while contributing to our evolving approach to AI-enabled communications.

  • Track what matters. Monitor earned media coverage, share of voice, sentiment, and survey impact to continually refine pitch strategy and messaging.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

You’re a PR pro with a journalist’s instinct for storytelling and a marketer’s eye for relevance. You don’t wait to be assigned work; you listen, observe, and connect the dots. You bring sharp editorial judgment and recognize newsworthiness instinctively. When you hear something promising in a meeting, roadmap review, or insights discussion, you immediately see the angleand you know it doesn’t stop at the press hit; you see how it plays on social, too.

You view earned media as a strategic lever, not an output, and know how to extract compelling narratives from raw inputs. You excel at turning insights into headlines, building lasting media relationships, asking smart questions, and translating complex topics into storylines across channels, including social.

Whether your background is agency, in-house or a mix of both, you thrive in fast-moving, content-rich environments. You’re curious, adaptable, and energized by how AI and new tools can elevate storytelling.

  • You’ve built strong relationships with key journalists and consistently secure meaningful coverage that advances our brand narrative.

  • Insights (i.e., data, trends, customer stories) regularly become compelling, timely, multi-channel narratives that show up across PR, blog, social and video.

  • Data studies and press wins consistently get a second life on social and executive leaders are publishing long-form LinkedIn articles tied to key research and results.

  • You’re viewed as an initiative-taking, strategic partner who brings earned media thinking into product conversations, content planning, and brand storytelling.

  • You’veestablished a predictable PR rhythm through a thoughtful media calendar, consistent outreach, and a steady flow of timely ideas.

  • You’ve helped sharpen how the brand shows up externally, contributing to a cohesive, insight-driven story in the market across earned media and social alike.

Requirements

  • 6-10+ years in PR, with B2B tech/SaaS experience

  • Existing relationships with top-tier and tech journalists

  • Strong news sense and ability to translate insights into stories

  • Direct pitching experience and comfort driving outbound media

  • Exceptional writing skills across formats: press releases, tailored pitches, bylines, spokesperson quotes, talking points

  • Fluency in social storytelling — able to spot how a press hit, data study, or executive moment should show up on social (especially LinkedIn) and comfortable partnering closely with a Social team to bring it to life

  • Skilled at managing cross-functional relationships

  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research and content development

  • Experience managing or partnering with PR agencies

Nice-to-Haves

  • Based in the Eastern time zone

  • Mixed background (agency + in-house)

  • Experience with data storytelling or insights-driven narratives, ideally including survey- or research-based campaigns

  • Experience partnering with a data-journalism or research agency on earned media campaigns

  • Familiarity with domains, hosting, website builders, or digital presence platforms

  • Experience in PR during a rebrand or brand transformation

Travel

Limited travel (approx. 1–3 trips per year for planning meetings, events, or media engagements)

Why you’ll love us.

  • We are in a major rebrand, and you’ll help shape how the world sees a legacy brand on the rise across press and social and LLMs.

  • Huge storytelling runway: millions of customers, a data-rich environment, and content engines across blog, survey, SEO, video, social and product.

  • A chance to influence visibility of a global brand across multiple channels.

  • A positive, high-growth environment where autonomy is paired with close leadership access and collaboration.

  • A cross-functional ecosystem that’s collaborative, energetic and committed to elevating our stories.

  • Opportunities to experiment with AI, data, and next-generation PR methodologies.

  • We’ve evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.

  • Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.

  • We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.

  • We care about you. We provide excellent Health Insurance options to fit you, HSA, Medical, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Life/AD&D/STD/LTD, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Generous vacation policy, and much more!

  • Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with #teamnewfold!

#NetworkSolutions

raw.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

The Reproductive & Genetic Health (RGH) Sales Specialist is responsible for driving commercial growth and market development of Illumina's reproductive health and clinical genomics portfolio across India. The individual will develop strategic customer relationships, drive clinician engagement and demand generation, support adoption of sequencing and library preparation solutions, and lead commercialization of new applications and initiatives within the reproductive and genetic health segment.

The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Clinical Application Specialists, Technical Support, and channel partners to accelerate market adoption and achieve business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Growth & Business Development

  • Achieve annual revenue, consumables, and growth targets within the assigned territory.
  • Develop and execute strategic business plans to expand Illumina's footprint in reproductive and genetic health.
  • Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities across hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, fertility centers, genetic testing laboratories, and healthcare institutions.
  • Drive instrument placements, consumable utilization, and recurring revenue growth.

Clinician Engagement & Demand Generation

Position Summary:

Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Bioproduction Group (BPG) is seeking a Senior Upstream Process Engineer (Commercial) to serve as a technical leader at the intersection of engineering, sales, and customer solutions. This role is responsible for defining and shaping upstream bioprocess solutions for capital projects supporting drug substance manufacturing, with a focus on cell culture media, bioreactors, and automation systems.

As a key member of the commercial organization, you will lead front-end engineering and proposal development (FEL/FEED) for customer capital investments, including both greenfield and brownfield facility expansions. You will translate customer process requirements into technically robust, commercially viable solutions while driving Thermo Fisher’s Bioproduction portfolio positioning.

This is a highly visible, customer-facing role working with leading biopharma companies, CDMOs, biotech firms, and engineering partners (A&E, EPCM).

Other Key Responsibilities Include:

Technical Leadership & Process Design

  • Lead upstream process design, including PFDs, P&IDs, balances, and equipment specs
  • Develop scalable solutions for media prep and bioreactor-based manufacturing with automation
  • Ensure compliance with cGMP and global regulatory standards

Front-End Engineering & Proposals

  • Lead FEL/FEED efforts, translating customer needs into defined scopes
  • Develop costed proposals with scope, assumptions, risks, and exclusions
  • Support CAPEX estimates aligned with commercial and margin goals

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as primary technical contact for customers and project teams
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and executive presentations
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across sales, engineering, and global teams

Thought Leadership & Market Development

  • Contribute to technical marketing (white papers, webinars, presentations)
  • Represent Thermo Fisher at industry events to promote bioproduction solutions

Project Transition & Execution Support

  • Ensure smooth handoff to execution teams with clear scope and continuity

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field required; Master’s or PhD preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in process engineering or bioprocess system design within the biopharma or life sciences industry
  • Strong expertise in upstream bioprocessing, including cell culture, media preparation, and single-use technologies
  • Experience with capital equipment projects and development of complex engineering proposals
  • Demonstrated ability to lead front-end engineering, scope definition, and technical solution development
  • Familiarity with automation platforms (e.g., DeltaV, PLC/SCADA systems) and integration within bioprocess facilities preferred
  • Strong understanding of cGMP and global regulatory frameworks (FDA, EMA, ICH)
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional and global teams
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging customer stakeholders and executive audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, customer-driven environment

Travel:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

The Internal Controls Associate is responsible for supporting and enhancing the organization's overall internal control environment across business operations, technology platforms, financial reporting, information security, regulatory compliance, and risk management activities. This role evaluates the design and effectiveness of controls, documents key processes and procedures, maintains evidence to demonstrate control performance, and collaborates with business and technology teams to identify, assess, and mitigate risks.

The Internal Controls Associate assists with internal audits, operational reviews, control testing and/or execution, remediation efforts, and compliance initiatives related to applicable laws, regulations, industry standards, and contractual obligations. Responsibilities extend beyond any single regulatory framework and may include supporting compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), privacy regulations, cybersecurity requirements, insurance industry regulations, and other governance, risk, and compliance obligations as applicable to the organization.

This position plays a key role in promoting a strong control culture by continuously assessing organizational risks, identifying control gaps, recommending improvements, and helping ensure that the company's overall control environment remains effective, sustainable, and aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Control Program Administration

  • Assist in the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organization's internal control framework.
  • Document and maintain policies, procedures, process flows, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and control narratives in alignment with COSO principles.
  • Ensure controls are appropriately designed to mitigate identified business, operational, financial, compliance, and technology risks.

Risk Assessment and Control Design

  • Perform periodic risk assessments across business and technology functions.
  • Identify control gaps, emerging risks, and process inefficiencies.
  • Develop and recommend risk mitigation strategies and control enhancements.
  • Support enterprise risk management and compliance initiatives.

Control Testing and Monitoring

  • Develop and execute control testing procedures to evaluate control design and operating effectiveness.
  • Analyze testing results, identify deficiencies, and track remediation activities.
  • Maintain evidence supporting control execution and effectiveness.
  • Monitor key controls through continuous auditing and data analytics techniques where applicable.

Regulatory and Compliance Support

  • Support compliance with applicable regulations, standards, and contractual obligations, including:
    • Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX)
    • State insurance regulations
    • Privacy regulations (CCPA, CPRA, GDPR, etc.)
    • Cybersecurity and information security requirements
    • SOC reporting, PCI DSS, and other industry-specific frameworks as applicable
  • Assist in preparing regulatory examinations, audits, and compliance assessments.

Audit Coordination and Management

  • Serve as a primary liaison for Internal Audit and external auditors.
  • Coordinate audit requests and facilitate walkthroughs, interviews, and evidence collection.
  • Respond to audit inquiries and support remediation efforts.
  • Track audit findings and ensure corrective actions are implemented timely.

Operational and Business Process Reviews

  • Evaluate operational processes to identify risks, inefficiencies, and control weaknesses.
  • Conduct special reviews and investigations relating to control failures, incidents, or identified concerns.
  • Participate in assessments related to fraud prevention, business continuity, vendor management, and cybersecurity.

Reporting and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready reports summarizing risks, control effectiveness, and recommendations.
  • Communicate findings and corrective action plans to business and technology leadership.
  • Escalate significant issues and emerging risks appropriately.
  • Present control-related information to management committees and stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, governance, and compliance processes.
  • Assist in developing metrics, dashboards, and reporting to monitor control effectiveness.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, risk awareness, and strong internal controls throughout the organization.
  • Stay informed on regulatory changes, emerging risks, and industry best practices affecting the insurance sector.

Other Duties

  • Support control, audit, risk management, governance, compliance, and operational initiatives as assigned by Internal Controls leadership.
  • Perform additional control-related activities necessary to maintain an effective enterprise-wide control environment.

Core Competencies that predict success in a high-accountability Internal Controls Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or Tech preferred
  • 1-2 years of experience in internal controls, external or internal audit positions.
  • Big four or banking experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver on commitments and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills.
  • Sound professional judgment and risk-based decision-making capabilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated accountability, ownership, and follow-through.
  • Strong listening skills and openness to coaching and feedback.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems, regulations, and business processes.
  • Proven ability to build effective working relationships and influence stakeholders.
  • Must demonstrate the organization’s core values, exuding behavior aligned with the firm’s culture.

Special Working Conditions:

Fast-paced, multi-tasking and agile environment.

Must be able to interact effectively with various levels of management both inside and outside the organization.

Important Notice:

This position description is intended to describe the level of work required of the person performing in the role and is not a contract. The essential responsibilities are outlined; other duties may be assigned as needs arise or as required to support the Firm.

You're the right fit if:

  • You’re a self-motivated sales professional with a strong hunter mentality, excellent discipline, and the ability to operate independently within a large, active territory.

Position title: Battery Simulation Engineer
Employment type: Full-time

Job description:

As a Battery Simulation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying electrical and thermal models of battery cells, modules, and full packs. Your work will directly support the development and integration of high-performance, safe, and reliable battery systems across various applications. This role requires a strong foundation in battery fundamentals, simulation techniques, high-voltage electrical circuits, and systems-level thinking. You will respond to technical requests using established tools and methodologies while also contributing to the development of new modeling approaches to address emerging challenges in battery safety and performance.

The responsibilities in this position include, but are not limited to:
- Develop and implement physics-based and empirical models for simulating the electrical, thermal, and degradation performance of lithium-ion battery systems.

  • Conduct 1D simulation studies to evaluate battery behavior under various electrical, thermal, and environmental conditions, including fast charging, thermal events, and aging.
  • Analyze laboratory test data to extract model parameters, validate simulation results, and improve model robustness.
  • Perform sensitivity studies, scenario simulation, and model-based evaluations to support design and engineering decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with cell, module, and pack design engineers, as well as test and control teams, to define requirements and optimize system performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations summarizing modeling methodology and simulation outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams and share progress and insights with stakeholders.

Basic qualifications:

  • Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Applied Physics from an ABET-accredited university.
    - Minimum of 2 years of experience using simulation tools for engineering applications.
    - Hands-on experience with 0D/1D battery simulation and analysis tools such as GT-SUITE, MATLAB/Simulink, Amesim, or equivalent.
    - Strong Understanding of lithium-ion battery fundamentals, including battery performance characteristics, thermal characteristics, and aging mechanisms.
  • Fundamental understanding of HV electrical circuits, busbar design, and Battery Disconnect Unit (BDU) functionality within a battery system.
  • Ability to analyze data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience with optimization methods (DOE, parameter estimation, control optimization).
    - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present technical findings to cross-functional teams.
    - Proven teamwork, interpersonal skills, and the ability to solve complex technical problems using analytical and simulation-based approaches.

Preferred qualifications:
- Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with a focus on battery systems, electrochemistry, or thermal management.
- Hands-on experience with battery testing methods, aging studies, and performance evaluation.
- Proficiency in developing and applying 0D/1D/3D simulation models for battery systems.
- Background in embedded controls, Kalman filters, or estimator design for SOC/SOH/SOP.
- Good overall knowledge of battery performance and thermal management.
- Good skills in programming with commercial software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Visual C++).

Applus IDIADA is committed to equality,diversity and inclusion. We don’t put limits on you, so don’t put limits on yourself either. There is a place for everyone.

Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

The Real World Evidence Manager is a highly technical, hands-on research role that serves as an analytical engine for iRhythm’s RWE and health economics program. Reporting to the Senior Ditector, Global Value and Access Innovation, this individual manages the execution and quality of quantitative analyses that generate the clinical, economic, and real-world evidence underpinning the Zio platform’s value proposition to US payers and health systems.

This role combines independent analytical execution with strong methodological rigor, carrying analytical workstreams from protocol through peer-reviewed dissemination. The RWE Manager serves as the primary programmer and model builder, producing analytical outputs that directly influence payer coverage decisions, health system contracting, and product strategy with secondary support for international (OUS) value and access workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

Real-World Evidence (RWE) Design & Execution

▪ Manage the execution of retrospective and prospective RWE studies using claims data (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial), EMR/EHR data, and proprietary iRhythm clinical datasets.

▪ Operationalize study protocols, analytic plans, variable definitions, and statistical methodologies appropriate for payer and peer-reviewed audiences.

▪ Apply advanced epidemiological methods including propensity score matching, instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, interrupted time series, and survival analysis.

▪ Ensure reproducibility, auditability, and documentation of all analytical pipelines.

Health Economic Modeling

▪ Build and maintain sophisticated health economic models including budget impact models (BIMs), cost-effectiveness models, and payer decision-support tools.

▪ Translate clinical evidence into economic inputs with appropriate uncertainty characterization.

▪ Develop and update payer-facing economic tools that field and account teams can deploy in customer engagements.

▪ Conduct sensitivity analyses, scenario modeling, and probabilistic analyses (PSA) consistent with HTA standards.

Statistical Programming & Data Infrastructure

▪ Serve as the primary statistical programmer for RWE and health economic projects, with proficiency in R, Python, SAS, or equivalent tools.

▪ Design and maintain analytical data infrastructure including datasets, codebooks, data dictionaries, and QC processes.

▪ Work with data vendors, CROs, and internal data science teams to access, clean, and validate data assets.

▪ Implement and maintain version-controlled analytical repositories (GitHub or equivalent).

Scientific Communication & Publication

▪ Prepare scientific abstracts, posters, and manuscripts for ISPOR, AMCP, ACC/AHA, HRS, and peer-reviewed journals.

▪ Translate complex analytical findings into clear, audience-appropriate formats for payer, clinical, and executive audiences.

▪ Co-author or contribute to health economic dossiers, coverage submissions, and payer value tools.

Cross-Functional Leadership

▪ Partner with Medical Affairs, Clinical Research, Commercial, and Payer Relations teams to align evidence generation with strategic priorities.

▪ Represent analytical workstreams in stakeholder engagements, as designated by the Director.

▪ Mentor interns and junior analysts on research methodology, data analysis, and scientific writing.

Qualifications

Required

▪ Masters or doctoral degree (MS, MPH, PhD) in Health Economics, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Public Health, or a highly quantitative related field.

▪ 3+ years of progressive experience in HEOR, RWE, or health economic analytics within the pharmaceutical, biotech, diagnostics, or digital health industry (or equivalent academic/consulting background).

▪ Expert-level proficiency in at least two of: R, Python, SAS, STATA for statistical analysis and data management.

▪ Demonstrated experience designing and executing observational studies using claims or EMR data.

▪ Strong track record of health economic model development (BIM, CEA, cost-utility models).

▪ Peer-reviewed publication record or equivalent demonstrated scientific output (abstracts, posters, dossier contributions).

▪ Strong analytical judgment and ability to execute rigorous analyses and communicate methodological choices clearly.

Preferred

▪ PhD in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Health Economics, or related field.

▪ Prior experience in cardiac electrophysiology, digital diagnostics, or ambulatory monitoring.

▪ Familiarity with US reimbursement structures (CMS, Medicare Advantage, commercial payers) and their evidentiary requirements.

▪ Experience with NCQA/HEDIS measure development or quality measurement frameworks.

▪ Proficiency with data platforms such as Optum Clinformatics, IBM MarketScan, TriNetX, or Komodo Health.

▪ Tableau or equivalent visualization platform experience.

Core Competencies

▪ Methodological Rigor: Applies advanced research methods with scientific independence and defensibility.

▪ Analytical Leadership: Drives analytical workstreams end-to-end with minimal supervision.

▪ Strategic Communication: Translates complex data into compelling, actionable insights.

▪ Cross-Functional Partnership: Works effectively with commercial, clinical, and policy stakeholders.

▪ Scientific Integrity: Upholds highest standards of research quality, reproducibility, and

  • Design and implement agentic AI architectures using frameworks such as LangChain, Strand Agents etc., enabling autonomous task planning, decision-making, and multi-step reasoning.

  • Experience with at least one of the workflow orchestration tools, Airflow, StepFunctions, SageMaker Pipelines, Kubeflow etc.

  • Experience implementing secure, scalable APIs and integrating with 3rd-party data sources and tools

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Developers, QA, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to understand their requirements and implement solutions.

Job Title: Finance Team Lead – Colombia

Location: Bogotá, Colombia – Remote
Employment Type: Full Time

Position Overview

The Finance Team Lead – Colombia is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day finance and accounting activities for AVEVA’s Colombian entity, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records, timely completion of month-end and year-end activities, and compliance with local statutory, tax, corporate and internal control requirements.

The role will lead the local Finance team and work closely with the LATAM Finance Director, regional Finance teams, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Commercial Finance and other global functions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate must be comfortable going into the detail, investigating accounting, tax or control issues, and working directly with the team to resolve them. The role requires someone who can combine strong technical accounting and Colombian tax knowledge with effective people management and stakeholder engagement.

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Colombia Finance team, setting clear objectives, priorities and expectations while ensuring strong performance, accountability and collaboration.

  • Take ownership of the accounting and financial reporting activities for the Colombian legal entity, ensuring the accuracy, completeness and integrity of financial records.

  • Manage the monthly, quarterly and year-end close processes, ensuring all activities are completed accurately and within corporate deadlines.

  • Maintain a hands-on approach to accounting activities, being able to review, investigate and resolve complex or unusual accounting issues rather than relying solely on team members or external advisors.

  • Review and oversee general ledger activities, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, intercompany transactions, balance sheet reconciliations and other period-end activities.

  • Ensure balance sheet accounts are properly reconciled, supported and reviewed, with timely investigation and resolution of aged or unreconciled items.

  • Coordinate local statutory accounting and financial statement preparation, working closely with external auditors and advisors as required.

  • Take an active role in Colombian tax matters, ensuring appropriate understanding, review and follow-up of local tax compliance requirements and tax-related accounting matters.

  • Work closely with internal Tax teams and external tax advisors, while maintaining sufficient technical knowledge and ownership to understand, challenge and validate tax positions and recommendations.

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audits, providing documentation and explanations and ensuring timely resolution of audit requests, questions and findings.

  • Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with AVEVA policies, SOX requirements and applicable local regulations.

  • Identify accounting, tax, financial, operational and compliance risks and escalate issues appropriately to the LATAM Finance Director and relevant stakeholders.

  • Work closely with Treasury on local banking, cash management, payments and other treasury-related activities.

  • Partner with Commercial Finance, Sales and other business stakeholders on finance-related matters affecting the Colombian entity.

  • Support revenue recognition and other accounting assessments, ensuring transactions are recorded in accordance with AVEVA accounting policies and applicable accounting standards.

  • Maintain close relationships with regional and global Finance stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of issues.

  • Drive process improvements, standardisation and automation opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of Finance operations.

  • Support regional Finance initiatives and projects as required.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Must Have

  • Strong accounting and financial reporting background with solid understanding of general ledger, balance sheet management and month-end/year-end close processes.

  • Strong knowledge of Colombian accounting, statutory and tax requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience dealing with Colombian tax matters and working with tax authorities and/or external tax advisors.

  • Previous experience coordinating statutory audits, tax compliance and external audit requirements.

  • Experience managing or supervising a Finance or Accounting team.

  • Strong hands-on approach, with the ability and willingness to investigate issues, understand the underlying transactions and work through the detail to reach a resolution.

  • Ability to combine people management responsibilities with direct involvement in accounting, tax, audit and control matters when required.

  • Strong understanding of internal controls, financial controls and operational risk.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, make sound judgements and appropriately escalate issues.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with local, regional and global stakeholders.

  • Ability to operate comfortably at both a detailed technical level and a managerial level.

  • High level of integrity and a strong commitment to compliance and ethical standards.

  • Ability to work effectively in a multinational and matrix organisation.

  • Fluent or strong professional English, with the ability to participate confidently in meetings and communicate effectively with regional and global stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience in a multinational company.

  • Experience working within a regional or global Finance organisation.

  • Experience with SOX/internal control environments.

  • Experience with Oracle or similar ERP systems.

  • Experience with technology, software or subscription-based businesses would be an advantage.

Technical / Professional Qualifications

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.

  • Professional accounting qualification in Colombia is preferred.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Experience with Oracle or similar ERP/accounting systems.

  • Good understanding of accounting standards and Colombian statutory reporting requirements.

Direct Reports

One local Finance assistant based in Colombia.

Key Stakeholders

  • LATAM Finance Director

  • LATAM Finance Team

  • Regional and Global Finance teams

  • Tax

  • Treasury

  • FP&A

  • Commercial Finance / Sales

  • Internal and External Audit

  • Legal and Compliance

  • External tax and accounting advisors

Finance at AVEVA

Our Finance professionals play a central role in supporting AVEVA’s global business. The Finance organisation covers areas including accounting and reporting, tax, treasury, FP&A, commercial finance, procurement, controls and risk management.

As part of a global and evolving organisation, the Colombia Finance Team Lead will have the opportunity to work closely with colleagues across LATAM and globally, while taking direct ownership of the financial operations and compliance of the Colombian entity.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional who enjoys combining hands-on accounting and tax expertise, team leadership and business partnership within an international environment.

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.

Come and join AVEVA to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.
